query: When did the Chernobyl disaster happen?
answer: The Chernobyl disaster happened in the early hours of 26 April 1986, at about 1:23 a.m. local time, at Reactor No. 4 of the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant in Soviet Ukraine [1][2]. Technicians had started a badly designed safety test on 25 April. During that test the chain reaction in the core went out of control, and explosions blew the heavy lid off the reactor [1][3]. One source gives the time as 01:23 Moscow Time (UTC+3), but the plant was on Moscow summer time then, so the correct offset is UTC+4 [2]. Pripyat, the nearby city of about 40,000 people, was evacuated the next day, 27 April [4].
